meta.notes: Chronicle templates for the province pack (world-2 L2, slices 1-2 — the road grammar re-voiced: the tavern/road syntax unchanged, the province's own prose; the loop change was L1's test, the DEPTH is L2's). Syntax: {slot} binds event data; #symbol# expands the tracery grammar; {cond?a|b} is ink-style conditional text; lists = alternatives via the ink-shuffle ShufflePool (cosmetic stream). tale_gate.min_importance decides which events earn a chronicle line. The world_history line's formed arm binds the six armed claim slots (weir_water/road_ground/keep_height/bank_ground/croft_hills/mill_bank — rules.json worldgen.claims). The cultures slice's tier pair (iter-119): road_counts the population tier's census at the macro crossings, road_musters the condensation — the {names?...|...} branch is the law (a bare {names} on a nameless condensation is an unknown slot, the drifted_from family); the drawn names list renders joined (render/tracery.py's sequence law). The calendar slice (slice 4): the market day's and the fair's lines plus the four seasons' own phase lines — each season's turn its own tale line (the cycle pairs' event types, never a shared template keyed on a raw id), the day coordinate riding the outcome beside the phase

events.stair_read_failed: {actor} studies {target}, but the steps stay steps.

events.tally_read_failed: {actor} studies {target}, but the notches stay notches.

events.location_burned_out: {location} burns out. Nothing will be the same here.

events.coerce: {actor} leans on {target} — the hold is spent.
events.ramble: {actor} rambles to no one in particular.
events.conclusion_drawn: {actor} had noticed it before, and named it: {knows}.
events.road_counts: On the year's turning, the road counts {population} souls still walking.
events.road_musters: {names?The road takes shape around the runner — {names} walking the artery together.|{actor} musters {members} strong at {location}.}

events.guild_councils: {actor} bars the stalls and puts its heads together at {location}.
events.wergeld_vigil: {actor} holds the wergeld vigil at {location} — the blood price spoken aloud again.
events.garrison_patrols: {actor} walks its round with a hard eye at {location}.
events.grief_wakes: The old grief wakes in {location} — the blood price remembered again.
events.market_opens: Day {day}: the river market opens at Malby — the stalls from the weir stair to the bank, the road traffic thick on the artery.
events.fair_opens: Day {day}: the month's fair at Malby — the guild's weighing, the season's trade told on the beam.
events.thaw_turns: Day {day}: the thaw — the weir runs loud with meltwater, the road soft to the ford.
events.high_water_rises: Day {day}: the river rises — the lower fords drown, the punt men charge double.
events.long_light_turns: Day {day}: the long light — the crofts green to the moor's edge, the road dry and fast.
events.first_frost_turns: Day {day}: first frost on the weir stair — the road hardens, the trade slows.
events.account_sourced: {target} comes by {amount} {kind} at the year's reckoning{flow? — {flow}}.
events.board_shared: {actor} shares the winter's board with {target} at {location} — the shelter law's meal, the stores eaten against the debt.
events.kin_stirs: The old kin stirs at {location} — the winter's board answering the drowned generation's notch, care's recipient bound to its bearer.
events.kinmark_read: {actor} reads the kin notch on the punt pole's haft — the winter's guests cut into the family's count, the same blade, the same staff, the flood-year mark a generation deep.
events.kinmark_read_failed: {actor} studies the punt pole's haft — the marks stay marks, the guest count missed.
events.kinmark_claimed: {actor} claims the kin notch at {location} — the flood-year guest's son at the crossing his father wintered at, the proof shown where the road can hear.
events.the_edge_answers: The old edge answers at {location} — the toll-taker's house holding the drowned generation's notch, the recognition the claim completes, the crossing's table open to the claimant's line from this day.
events.the_names_kept: {actor} says the drowned generation's names at {location} — the flood year's dead kept by name outside the bloodline, their own futures the flood took down with them, the line, the duties and the holdings that were to be theirs, the grief given its second holder.
events.the_house_answers: The toll-taker's house answers at {location} — the winter's board eaten against the debt, the notch's own count kept, the edge standing both ways.
